title: HUD wedge colors
description: The colors of the battle HUD's type wedges (docs/paperwhite2/plugins.md, Type Icons): for every type, the wedge's fill and its darker edge. tools/paperwhite2/type_colors.py checks the file and writes the colors, rounded to the DS's 5 bits an axis, into paperwhite2/type_colors_config.h for src/paperwhite2/ov168/paperwhite2_type_icons.c.

types.description: Every type of generated/types.txt, by constant. TYPE_NULL's are the typeless move's (Roost's), a copy of Normal's

color.description: Red, green and blue from 0 to 255; the DS shows 5 bits an axis, so the game rounds each to the nearest of 32 levels

fill.description: The wedge's fill: a monotype's upper field, and a dual type's fields (its first and second type)

edge.description: A monotype's second field, the darker shade; a dual type never shows its edge
